primary_comparison_direction: positive gain difference favors named method
uniform_expected_note: Monte Carlo average of 100 allocations per root; not 100 extra independent roots
oracle_note: max of noisy independent-audit means, so absolute regret has oracle-estimation bias; paired gain contrasts do not use max
global_voi_heuristic_note: matched-posterior sequential std/(1+abs(proxy)); not original author Global-VOI execution
covariance_note: calibration only; diagonal audit-noise correction; root bootstrap does not prove posterior calibration
evidence_rule: registered primary paired 95% root-bootstrap lower bound >0; null/negative results retained
source_scope: New exploratory MetaDrive native bottleneck response extension; finite shared-controller response search, not independently learning neural agents, not official adaptive MetaDrive score, not exact best response. Candidate policies prespecified before pilot outcomes. Same fixed profile-query sizes for all methods; no stopping/menu claims.

native_experiment_cost.note: includes all response searches, proxy, query bank, validation and audits; not a single selector's online cost

budget_accounting: For q>0: incumbent response setup h*2 + q*(h*2 + 2*selection_episodes) native episodes. Proxy common to all methods. Audits and all-candidate precomputed bank counted separately as experimental cost; algorithms access only selected query blocks.
author_comparison_scope: author E5C batch allocation and author outcome rules; separate from matched joint-posterior selectors; all author contrasts secondary
secondary_warning: other budgets/responses/method contrasts are secondary; no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim is made
plots_note: shaded bands are marginal root-bootstrap 95% intervals; significance uses paired primary contrast, not overlap of these bands
